FT-NIR platforms for teaching and research

From laboratory learning to process research.

MPA III supports flexible method development, TANGO II makes routine FT-NIR approachable, and BEAM brings contactless analysis into process research.

MPA III · FLEXIBLE RESEARCH & SHARED FACILITIES

One platform. Multiple research directions.

A modular FT-NIR platform for laboratories that need flexibility across liquids, solids and semi-solids, routine work and sophisticated method development.

  • Multiple sampling approaches
  • Quantitative and qualitative method development
  • Suitable for laboratory and factory-floor research
Download MPA III flyer ↗
TANGO II · TEACHING & ROUTINE ANALYSIS

Make FT-NIR easier to learn and use.

Compact and designed for intuitive operation, TANGO II supports users with different experience levels and is well suited to routine teaching and shared laboratory workflows.

  • Guided, intuitive operation
  • Options for liquids or solids and semi-solids
  • Compact footprint for teaching environments
Download TANGO II brochure ↗
BEAM · PROCESS RESEARCH & MONITORING

Bring FT-NIR into the process.

BEAM is a single-point FT-NIR spectrometer for contactless, real-time analysis of solids and semi-solids in applied process research.

  • Measure directly over conveyors, hoppers or pipelines
  • Explore process monitoring and method transfer
  • Use in laboratory development or pilot-scale studies
Download BEAM brochure ↗

Before choosing an instrument

Map the programme first.

A useful academic platform starts with six practical questions.

01

Define the users

Undergraduates, postgraduates, researchers, technicians, external partners or a shared mix?

02

Map the samples

Liquids, powders, tablets, agricultural materials, polymers, chemicals or live process streams?

03

Set the learning depth

Routine measurement, qualitative identification, quantitative calibration, chemometrics or process control?

04

Plan the journey

Should the platform stay in the lab or support fieldwork, pilot plants and industry collaboration?

05

Understand access

Is this dedicated to one group or expected to serve multiple departments and research projects?

06

Design for later

What new methods, applications or collaborations should the investment be able to support?
